rules.accepted_credit_types: CE approved by national or state nursing organizations, other state boards of nursing or NM board-approved local monitoring systems; CE from institutions of higher learning; academic credit (1 credit = 15 contact hours); national specialty certification/recertification
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is not required for the initial license; it applies from the first renewal and may be prorated to the length of the renewal period.
rules.audit_note: CE records are subject to board audit; keep certificates at least 1 year after renewal; non-compliance within 60 days of audit notice may lead to discipline.
rules.notes: Renew by the end of the renewal (birth) month every two years. The board FAQ asks nurses to have CE uploaded in CE Broker before renewing, then attest. Military on active duty are exempt from CE.
